readme.run: Deconvolve a 3D microscopy stack with Richardson-Lucy or RL-TV
notes: Input is a single-channel 3D TIFF, OME-TIFF, ImageJ TIFF or NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz) stack.
Choose --modality widefield (default) or confocal, or supply a measured bead stack with --psf.
Choose --method rl (default) or rltv with --tv-weight and --iterations.
Add --help for every optical parameter, voxel size override, and output option.
No network connection is required and no external models are downloaded.
Please cite Gibson & Lanni 1991, Richardson 1972 / Lucy 1974, and Dey et al. 2006 (RL-TV).
